title: moeb-tool-origin failed: ToolSearch and Read used without MissingMoebTool signals
description: During this spec session, ToolSearch was called multiple times to load moeb tool schemas (write_file, create_task_list, complete_review, enter_phase, read_file, patch_file, get_run_status, verify_rubrics), and Read was called multiple times to read the spec prompt output file that exceeded the MCP inline size limit. These are external tools not in the moeb tool registry. No MissingMoebTool signals were buffered for these calls, and moeb-tool-origin was submitted as Pass rather than Fail.
proposed_resolution: The start_spec preload block should include all tool schemas needed during a spec session, eliminating ToolSearch calls. A native moeb tool for paginated reading of oversized output files should be introduced. Until then, buffer MissingMoebTool signals for each external call and submit moeb-tool-origin as Fail with acknowledged_failures.
